data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1 (074b): dispatching gov-copy-writer with a sample Copy Needs section produces a YAML file at the configured copy_dir that validates against the gov-copy-artifact schema

## Description
Create plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md with required YAML frontmatter (name: gov-copy-writer, model: sonnet, description: ...) and the dispatch prompt body. Prompt body documents:
- Inputs: Copy Needs section, top-K canon entries (K<=20), copy_dir path, design context (if design:approved tag)
- Output: YAML artifact at <copy_dir>/<epic-id>.yaml conforming to plugins/dso/docs/contracts/gov-copy-artifact.md (placeholder reference — schema created in story 26a7)
- Behavior: produce per-item values{label, hint, errors{}} and structured rationale{rule_ids, conflicts, deviations} citing canon rule_ids; leave checks{} block unset (deterministic post-processor owns it)

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md exists with frontmatter and body; When test-gov-copy-writer-agent.sh validates the file; Then frontmatter has name=='gov-copy-writer', model=='sonnet', description is non-empty, and prompt body references the precedence ladder + top-K cap + structured rationale schema.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Agent file exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md
- [ ] Frontmatter declares name, model, description
  Verify: head -10 plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md | grep -E '^name:' && head -10 plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md | grep -E '^model: sonnet' && head -10 plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md | grep -E '^description:'
- [ ] Prompt documents precedence ladder verbatim
  Verify: grep -q 'canon-rule > Copy Needs constraint > Users archetype > design-notes voice' plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md
- [ ] Prompt documents top-K cap K<=20
  Verify: grep -qE 'K\s*<=\s*20|top-K.*20' plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md
- [ ] Behavioral test passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-gov-copy-writer-agent.sh
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-gov-copy-writer-agent.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
| plugins/dso/agents/gov-copy-writer.md | Create |
| plugins/dso/tests/test-gov-copy-writer-agent.sh | Create |
| plugins/dso/tests/.test-index | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at escalation time: skip opus, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Author gov-copy-writer sub-agent file with frontmatter, model:sonnet, and dispatch prompt
